title: NumberStepField
summary: The two stepper chevrons were 12 x 12px targets. Each is now a half-height tile, 24 x 19px, with a neutral grey hover fill, so it is easy to hit and shows what will be pressed; at rest it still looks like two bare chevrons. Holding a tile repeats the step (first repeat after 400ms, then every 60ms) and stops on release, on leaving the tile, or at the minimum / maximum.
why: Mantine NumberInput and HeroUI NumberInput both repeat the step while the button is held (Mantine: 500ms then ~50ms); stepping 0 to 30 minutes with 30 clicks of a 12px target is the pain this removes.
12px targets are half the 24px WCAG 2.5.8 minimum; stacking two controls in a 38px field allows at most 19px tall tiles.

scenarioLabels.click-up-once: After one click on increase (value 1 to 2)
scenarioLabels.hold-up-1200ms: Held for 1.2s (after only: value before release, right after, 300ms after)
scenarioLabels.hold-down-to-minimum: Held on decrease until the minimum (after only)

motion.after: Tile background transparent to --semantic-bg-ui #F5F5F5 in 150ms ease-out, chevron colour as before; hover only on devices that can hover
The whole tile scales .96 (80ms down, 180ms back, spring)

First repeat 400ms after pointer down, then every 60ms; stops on pointer up, leave, cancel, or when the value reaches min/max. Measured in Chrome: 1 to 16 over about 1.5s, then 16 right after release and 16 300ms later (no extra step from the click)

states: Stepper tile / default: transparent, chevron 12px muted #707070
Stepper tile / hover: fill --semantic-bg-ui #F5F5F5, radius 4px, chevron --v2-text-primary #484848
Stepper tile / disabled (disabled field or at a bound): chevron opacity 40%, no hover fill (unchanged)
figmaSteps: Stepper column: width 28px (was 20px), full field inner height 38px, horizontal padding 2px, vertical auto layout, no gap, fill --semantic-bg-primary #FFFFFF.

Each stepper becomes a tile: 24 x 19px (fill the column width and half the height), radius 4px, centred 12px chevron (ChevronUp on top, ChevronDown below), fill transparent. The chevrons therefore sit 2.5px further from the field's vertical centre line and 2px further from the unit label than before; everything else in the field is unchanged.
Hover variant of a tile: fill --semantic-bg-ui #F5F5F5, chevron --v2-text-primary #484848. Smart Animate 150ms ease out.
Pressed variant: tile scale 96%, 80ms ease-out in, 180ms Gentle spring back.
Annotate the interaction: holding a tile steps repeatedly (400ms delay, then 60ms interval) and stops at min/max or on release; a quick click is one step.
The numeric input is 8px narrower (column went from 20px to 28px); the unit label ('hour') block is unchanged.
notes: Clamping, keyboard behaviour, Tab order (both buttons stay tabbable) and the pointer-down focus handling are unchanged. The click path is untouched; a click that follows a held press is ignored for 600ms so a hold never double-steps.

Rest appearance differs by a few pixels: the column is 8px wider and the two chevrons are 5px further apart (tile centres 19px apart instead of 14px). Keeping them exactly where they were would put the chevron off-centre inside its tile.

Repeat timing uses setTimeout/setInterval (no animation library). A controlled parent that updates `value` on each change gets 1 step per tick; a parent that ignores updates still receives the intended next values up to the bound.
The hold scenarios have no before image: the previous behaviour was a single step per click (see click-up-once).
The 'pressed' before image was recorded from a temporary copy of the previous component, so its page layout is not centred like the after image.
